lines: A sudden evening shower falls; I hate that I have no umbrella.
I don't know the sky's mood.
What should I wear for the changing seasons?
Where did spring and autumn go?
The pressure of information leaves me breathless.
It's a spiral of dizziness; where am I?
Even though my breathing sounds so loud,
It's strange, I hear no sound from the world.
It's insufficient, unnoticed by anyone.
I screamed while unable to produce even a scribble-like noise.
Who would I show my unaltered self to?
Foolish me, I only sing.
Should I pour it all out to the stars?
Even the task of swapping in elixir feels vague.
I lightly touch my chipped nail.
With a body only 300 mm in radius, I scream desperately.
To the music, this is Earth.
I grasp the air and strike the sky.
Nothing happens; I am powerless.
But if you flick this iron with your hand,
It seemed as if something had changed.
Bright, bright—don't shine so much.
My uncool shadow ends up deepening even more, regrettably.
Why am I getting this hot? It won't stop.
Foolish me, I only sing.
My heart is noisy.
An azure planet, all alone.
I've heard a multitude of sounds.
Spinning on for billions of years.
Even for a moment, ah.
Listen.
Hear this!
I, I, I am here.
I screamed while unable to produce even a scribble-like noise.
I want to become something, anything, just to be someone.
Foolish me, I only sing.
Should I pour it all out to the stars?
